gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-vithku: Expressive and a bit artful, Bushcraft spaces its letters far apart. Noto Sans Vithkuqi, a plain sans with open throats on a, c, e and s, would carry a long passage smoothly, its capitals barely stepping above the lowercase.
